تَهْ , (JK,) or تُهْ تُهْ, (K,) An expression imitative of the ↓ مُتَهْتِه , [i. e., of him who has the faulty utterance termed تَهْتَهَةٌ,] (JK, K, TA, [in the CK, المُتَتَهْتِهِ is put for المُتَهْتِهِ,]) consisting in a distortion of the tongue. (JK.) ―
-b2- تُهْ تُهْ is also A cry by which one chides the camel, (K, TA,) and which makes him to run away. (TA.) ―
-b3- And A call to a dog. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
